content.short: Houdini offers non-custodial cross-chain swaps across 100+ chains with privacy features.
content.description: Houdini performs non-custodial swaps across more than a hundred chains with a privacy layer sitting between the sending and receiving addresses. Users can swap without connecting a wallet, or route through an on-chain DEX path, and the product also supports batch swaps, payment links and a browser extension. A partner portal and developer API let other services embed the same routing. The company positions itself as compliant privacy and not a mixer. It also runs referral and rewards programs.
content.meta: Non-custodial swaps across 100+ chains with a privacy layer between sender and recipient.
